explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in body context, then walked tokens with `next_token()`. For each ordinary `#text` token I compared the decoded text from `get_modifiable_text()` and, on a case-sensitive match, wrapped the token’s normalized serialization from `serialize_token()` in `<mark>`; everything else is emitted unchanged so the result stays normalized.
